title: A Concordance Invariant For Knots from $CFK^\infty$
summary: We construct a multi-filtered smooth knot concordance invariant, $β(t^1, a, t^2)$, derived from the knot Floer complex $CFK^\infty$. $β$ is a three-variable piecewise linear function defined on $(0,2) \times \mathbb{R} \times (0,2)$. We demonstrate that $β$ satisfies a subadditivity relation. We apply $β$ to prove concordance results for a certain family of L-space knots. We show that the positive cones spanned by Teragaito's knots $K_{1,n}$ and $K_{2,n}$ are disjoint in the smooth concordance group $\mathcal{C}$.
